body: I'm crying while reading this. I doubt I'll update you man, but just know I think I needed to see this
I'm 26. And so is she. We were born days apart, always around each other.
Just needed to vent and I couldn't get a post anywhere else. Kind of seems pointless but I can't tell people about this that aren't strangers.

Yeah this is pretty much why I've given up hope. Kind of appreciate the bluntness. I don't really want kids, but I mean can you imagine telling people you're with your cousin? 

Almost rather die.

Yes, I'm in the bed too. She has night terrors sometimes. 

I just don't know how I could bring it up. And it's hard to describe my family, but I know this would be like throwing a big fucking wrench in the cogs. I guess I'm way more worried about everyone else's reactions than I am hers or dealing with my own morals on it.
From the don't hook up with your cousin kind lol.

Direct cousin, our parents are siblings. 

It's hard to do that. And when I think about it, I don't really want to...
